name: aiwatcher-mcp
description: AI news ingestion, distillation, and alert system. Polls RSS/Atom and optional Gmail/arXiv/Readly, scores items with Claude or local LLMs, delivers digests, and fires fleet alerts (robofang, speechops). REST + MCP HTTP on :10946, stdio MCP via python -m aiwatcher_mcp.server.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.title: Anthropic API Key
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for Claude distillation and digest generation

ALERT_THRESHOLD.title: Alert Threshold
ALERT_THRESHOLD.description: Urgency score (0-10) above which TTS wake-up fires. Default: 8.5
